bubble.means: a messaging-app bubble with one square corner and delivery dots

icon.means: the icon knocked out of a coloured disc (the classic)

mark.means: a thick tapered brush stroke, no container
a tilted double-ringed stamp around the mark
a ruled box ticked by hand, the mark overflowing it

texture.means: a dot screen fading out of one corner
diagonal hatching in the shaded band

entrance.means: things are drawn or wiped on, as if by hand
things drop in and land, panels settle
things pop in with a little overshoot (the classic)

camera.means: cuts between held frames (guidance for the storyboard)
